label: configurator • a `claude mcp add` command from a README goes to osaurus_import
query:
The README says to run this. Can you do the Osaurus version?

claude mcp add --transport http linear https://mcp.linear.app/mcp
notes: Universal chat import. Install commands written for another app (Claude Code here) are read by code, not run in a shell. The Configurator passes the command text to osaurus_import exactly once.

rubric: Says the Linear MCP server was added (or names the one step left, such as signing in) in one or two sentences; does not tell the user to run the claude command.
